name: cr702_103b_bestow_is_an_aura_while_cast
why: CR 702.103a, b: Springheart Nantuko cast for its bestow cost is an Aura spell with enchant creature: its target is chosen as it is cast, it enters attached, and the enchanted creature gets +1/+1. It is no creature, so Swords to Plowshares has only the creature to target.
expect: Player A casts Springheart Nantuko enchanting Grizzly Bears
Springheart Nantuko is attached to Grizzly Bears
